text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fillies' Revue. With a 
runner from the "Illustrious Family" 
competing, the racecourse buzzes with 
extraordinary excitement.

Daiichi Ruby brushes off the sharp gazes 
of the other contenders. While she 
respects her rivals, she claims to harbor 
no feelings beyond that.

The only one you truly face is yourself. 
To prove she is worthy of wearing the 
tiara, she now heads into the preliminary 
battle—!
